gloss: to send to each other; to exchange (messages, gifts)

definitions.gloss: to send to one another; to exchange back and forth
definitions.explanation: For two or more parties to send something to each other mutually, such as messages, photos, or gifts. A compound of {送|おく}る (to send) and {合|あ}う (to do mutually).

examples.japanese: {毎日|まいにち}メッセージを{送|おく}り{合|あ}う。
examples.english: We send each other messages every day.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}と{写真|しゃしん}を{送|おく}り{合|あ}った。
examples.english: I exchanged photos with a friend.

examples.japanese: {年末|ねんまつ}になると、{家族|かぞく}や{友人|ゆうじん}とプレゼントを{送|おく}り{合|あ}うのが{習慣|しゅうかん}だ。
examples.english: At the end of the year, it's a custom to exchange presents with family and friends.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Transitive godan verb. The thing exchanged is marked with を and the other party with と: (person)と Xを{送|おく}り{合|あ}う. The {合|あ}う suffix adds the sense of mutual, reciprocal action.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メッセージを{送|おく}り{合|あ}う: to exchange messages
- {写真|しゃしん}を{送|おく}り{合|あ}う: to send each other photos
- エールを{送|おく}り{合|あ}う: to cheer each other on
